features.title: Arcadians: ancient to future
features.summary: Pointer, four-beat playback pulse, quality tiers and a ten-section journey.
features.instructions: Follow the live Arcadians page’s structure; this is a teaching adaptation, not a saved production page.

features.title: Page metadata and revisions
features.summary: Set BPM, timing attachments, lyric opt-in and ambient effect.
features.instructions: The sidebar is a local simulator. IDs 9001/9002 are fixtures, never real WordPress attachment IDs.

features.title: Musical clock and CSS timing
features.summary: Inspect ticks, pips, beats, bars, duration quantisation and clock selection.
features.instructions: Watch the page clock before playback, then compare the explicit audio clock.

features.title: Starts, beats and interval handlers
features.summary: One-shot and repeating scheduling; deferred CSS starts; cancellation.
features.instructions: Start audio, register a beat/bar callback, cancel it, then try a deferred entrance.

features.title: Named cues, events and animation ownership
features.summary: File parsers, normalised names, manual cues, exact seek landings and owned animation resets.
features.instructions: Seek to Drop 1 while paused, then play. Compare owned animation with the theme’s unowned spinner.

features.title: Canonical lyrics and look-ahead
features.summary: Built-in popover, custom onLyric listener, immediate-next and next-visible lyric values.
features.instructions: Seek to 2.89, 7.76 and 7.81 seconds to inspect sung, blank-clear and next-line states.

features.title: Master-length audio discovery
features.summary: Bind two copies of the master; derive a short Arcadians excerpt and show why it is excluded.
features.instructions: The eight-second excerpt is cut from the same MP3 in your browser, not a different demonstration song.

features.title: Bounded pointer and parallax
features.summary: Cached bounds, clamped input, custom render, reset and teardown.
features.instructions: Move over the stage or use the manual controls. Manual set is not physical sensor evidence.

features.title: Audio-phase pulse
features.summary: Duration/delay CSS variables, playback-rate changes, seeking and pause.
features.instructions: Play, change rate, seek to a chapter, pause and inspect the CSS phase.

features.title: Finite cue-triggered class
features.summary: Cue subscription, retriggering, bounded wall-clock lifetime, fire and clear.
features.instructions: Fire DROP 1. This finite class is not an audio-restored interval; its timer does not freeze on pause.

features.title: Restorable cue timeline
features.summary: Crossing detection, no replay of skipped cues, active interval reconstruction and restore.
features.instructions: Seek into a Drop, backwards into a Verse, pause, resume, and use manual restore.

features.title: Recoverable quality tiers
features.summary: Measured quality, manual tier selection, registry get/snapshot/teardown.
features.instructions: Manual tier buttons demonstrate styling only; they do not fabricate low-frame-rate evidence.

features.title: CSS catalogue adoption
features.summary: Animation/transition timing conversion, dynamic markup and ownership scope.
features.instructions: Insert a timed element, reapply conversion and inspect its computed duration.

features.title: All nine orientation mappings
features.summary: Production orientation wrapper plus synthetic desktop inputs and native phone permission UI.
features.instructions: Choose each adapter in the selector. Synthetic slider input is explicitly untrusted; use a real phone for genuine events.

features.title: Orientation helpers and schedulers
features.summary: Screen alignment, normalisation, rolling mapper, frame scheduler and target scheduler.
features.instructions: Helper-level controls show the numbers and bounded commits without requesting sensor permissions.

features.title: Clay adapter with Arcadians audio
features.summary: Clay motion/settings, cues, lifecycle, snapshots and automatic clay_background rudiment.
features.instructions: A compact educational Clay-shaped fixture uses Arcadians at 145 BPM. It does not reproduce or change the Clay release page.

features.title: Paper-plane ambient effect
features.summary: Page-selected paper planes, compact mode, offscreen pause, snapshots and teardown.
features.instructions: Effect metadata is paper-planes. The supplied plane atlas is from DanceMoves, not a fabricated copy.

features.title: All 15 native rudiments
features.summary: Catalogue, descriptions, native sampling, pips/ticks conversion and CSS renderer.
features.instructions: Select every pattern; inspect exact integer samples; pause, disable, reset and destroy the controller.

features.title: Rudiment custom renderer and clocks
features.summary: Canvas callback, signed rate/phase, page/audio/auto clocks, cue reset and 3D output.
features.instructions: Switch clocks while stopped and remount. Rendering uses upstream offsets, never local motion formulas.

features.title: Bounded diagnostics and events
features.summary: Opt-in diagnostics sink, handler IDs, diagnostic snapshots and sink removal.
features.instructions: Diagnostics is a code-only boot option, not a page metadata key. Records are bounded and stay local.

features.title: Accessibility and lifecycle
features.summary: Reduced-motion/forced-colour checks, explicit disable, pause/resume, offscreen and teardown.
features.instructions: Use browser accessibility emulation or OS settings; tab away and return. A manual disable is not media-query emulation.

features.title: MP3 download versus playback
features.summary: Signed GET/HEAD download simulation and normal byte-range audio playback.
features.instructions: Local-only route models the plugin response. It neither uses WordPress salts nor contacts the live site.

features.title: Motion capture REST contract
features.summary: Synthetic capture JSON, bounded local endpoint and validation error examples.
features.instructions: No real sensor data is collected or uploaded here. This is not the production capture endpoint.
